_file_header.weight_derivation_note: Hallmark link weights in companion compound file are derived from evidence_strength + human_evidence; biomarker thresholds here use clinical_consensus where no single PMID supports a numeric cutoff.
_file_header.weight_rationale: Equal weights applied. Lopez-Otin 2013 (PMID 23746838) and 2023 (PMID 36599349) present hallmarks as interconnected without quantitative ranking. No published systematic review assigns differential weights. Nature 2022 critical review (PMID 35880523) notes hallmarks are defined phenomenologically, not quantitatively.
_file_header.weight_source: absence of evidence for differential weighting

grimage_components.description: GrimAge: DNAm surrogates for 7 plasma proteins plus DNAm pack-years

_file_header.phenoage_note: Clinical PhenoAge / phenotypic age (Levine 2018, PMID 29676998, Table 1 Gompertz weights) uses albumin, creatinine, glucose, CRP (log), lymphocyte%, MCV, RDW, alkaline phosphatase, WBC + chronological age — not GGT. CRP enters as log(CRP) continuously; it does not define an optimal 0.5 mg/L threshold.

longevity_optimal.source_note: Derived from geroscience literature and clinical metabolic health targets; no single PMID establishes this specific cutoff for longevity.
